items.summary: Russian forces struck Kharkiv and 13 other settlements in Kharkiv region over the past day, killing four people and leaving six others affected, Head of Kharkiv Regional Military Administration Oleh Synehubov has reported.

items.title: Russian drone attacks on 4 Dnipropetrovsk region districts injure man – regional administration
items.summary: Russian forces attacked four districts of Dnipropetrovsk region with drones, leaving one person injured, Head of Dnipropetrovsk Regional Military Administration Oleksandr Hanzha has reported.

items.title: Russian strike on Kharkiv kills 2, leaves 3 others affected
items.summary: At least two people were killed after a Russian drone struck a multi-storey residential building in Novobavarsky district of Kharkiv, Mayor Ihor Terekhov has reported.

items.title: Electric-powered transport comes to standstill in Kryvyi Rih, water and heating services switch to generators
items.summary: Oleksandr Vilkul has said that significant electricity problems hit central Kryvyi Rih after a Russian attack on an infrastructure facility, stopping electric-powered public transport and shifting utilities to backup generators.

items.title: Defense Forces neutralize 2,319 Russian troops, 4 aircraft in past day – General Staff
items.summary: Ukraine's Defense Forces neutralized 2,319 Russian troops and four aircraft over the past day, the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine has reported.

items.title: Air defense downs 87 of 113 Russian drones, strikes recorded at 20 locations – Air Force
items.summary: Ukrainian air defense forces neutralized 87 of 113 Russian attack drones overnight on Thursday, the Ukrainian Air Force has reported.

items.title: EU leaders face showdown over Ukraine funding as divisions deepen
items.summary: European Union leaders on Thursday are set to tackle deep divisions as they meet in Brussels to discuss the bloc's long-term budget in Brussels, which includes a proposed €45 billion loan to keep Ukraine funded through 2027.

items.title: Russia loses another 2,319 troops and four aircraft in war against Ukraine in past 24 hours
items.summary: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from 24 February 2022 to 26 November 2026, amount to approximately 1,645,899 personnel, of whom 2,319 were lost in the past 24 hours.
